context.summary: Recombinant ACE2 (YFP-tagged, His-tagged) reconstituted into POPC/POPG liposomes that are assembled on citrate-coated gold nanoparticles (Au@R/Li). Used as an LSPR sensor to detect SARS-CoV and SARS-CoV-2 spike S1 protein; the liposome is studied as a sensing platform.

context.summary: Acalabrutinib-loaded polymer-lipid hybrid nanoparticles (PLHNs) made of mPEG-PCL (lipophilic or hydrophilic grade), DPPC, lecithin and Tween 80, designed to improve the oral bioavailability of acalabrutinib. Physicochemical characterization and in vivo rat pharmacokinetics.

samples.composition: acalabrutinib + hydrophilic mPEG-PCL (Mw 23,615.84 Da) + DPPC + lecithin, Tween 80 stabiliser
